statement: The Ninth Massachusetts Battery left Taneytown on the morning of 2 July and arrived at Gettysburg at 10 a. m., going into park on the left of the Taneytown road with the rest of the reserve.

place.printed: on the left of the Taneytown road with the rest of the reserve

source.author: Lieut. Richard S. Milton
source.quote: Arrived at Gettysburg at 10 a. m.
source.cite: OR Ser. I vol. 27 pt. 1, OR27-1-R320 Lieut. Richard S. Milton, p. 886
